observations: White truck with orange drilling rig mounted on the chassis.
The rig features a long telescopic mast and a hydraulic pump unit.
The truck cab has a 'DONGFENG' logo on the grille.
The rig mast has a large blue logo, possibly 'HONGYU' or 'HONGYUAN', but it is not clearly legible.
The truck is parked on a dirt surface with other construction equipment visible in the background.
The rig appears to be in a used condition with some surface rust and dirt.

claims.evidence: The equipment shown is a mobile drilling rig.
The condition of the drill bits is not visible in the photos.
There are no photos showing the rig powered on or drilling.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The rig may not be hydraulically functional or may have a leak.
risks.proof: A video showing the mast extending and retracting while the rig is powered on.

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have high mileage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and running.

risks.risk: Essential drilling accessories (bits, pumps, hoses) may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of all included rig components laid out.

risks.risk: The rig may be structurally unstable or have hidden frame damage.
risks.proof: A video of the rig being operated and the mast being raised.

proof_requests: Video of the rig powered on with the mast moving.
Video of the engine starting and running.
Photo of all included drilling accessories.
Photo of the engine and transmission area.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
